title: Budget Guard
mission: Check a fictional project budget against funding-call rules and find the calls it can actually apply to.
steps: Show the draft budget as a table: cost, requested grant and co-funding per partner.
Check the draft against one call: duration, partners, overhead share, funding rate and total grant.
Let the user edit a number and see the problems update.
List the calls that are open, fit the rules and share at least one topic, best match first.
checks: Totals and co-funding add up and match a hand calculation.
Each broken rule names the partner it concerns; exactly 30 % overhead is allowed.
The untouched draft is eligible for no call; a fixed budget is eligible for C4 and C1.
validation: Show why each rejected call was rejected, in plain words.
extension: Let an LLM explain the problems to the applicant or propose work packages, and check its suggestion with your own rules.
hint: Calculate one partner's cost by hand first. Money rules break at exact limits, so compare carefully.
